title: OSMR breast cancer: Figure 1 and Figure 4 analysis code

creators.name: Park, Sungjin
creators.affiliation: Institute of Human Behavior & Genetics, Korea University Anam Hospital, Korea University College of Medicine, Seoul, Republic of Korea

description:
Analysis scripts, plotting code and documentation for the in silico components of the manuscript Clinical significance of OSMR expression and divergent growth responses to oncostatin M in breast cancer cells (Park S, Nguyen DT, Cho M, In S, Kim J, Hurh S, Park YS, Choi J, Kim W-K, Choi Y, Park BJ, Hwang J-I), submitted to the Journal of Experimental & Clinical Cancer Research, 2026.

The repository covers Figure 1 (TCGA breast invasive carcinoma expression, survival and Cox analyses, receptor correlations, MCP-counter deconvolution, Hallmark scoring, and single-cell atlas analysis including CopyKAT-resolved epithelial labels, OSM signaling potential and NATMI-style edge specificity) and Figure 4 (cell-line RNA sequencing preprocessing, limma-trend fits, Welch and Holm testing, moderated effects with confidence intervals, and Hallmark GSEA). The remaining figures report wet-laboratory measurements and have no analysis code.

No data are distributed in this archive. Input expression matrices, clinical tables, cached objects, gene-set databases, statistical results and figure files must be obtained from their original sources as documented in docs/INPUTS.md. The breast cancer single-cell atlas is NCBI GEO accession GSE176078. The cell-line RNA sequencing generated for this study is NCBI GEO accession GSE351205, to be released on publication.
